name: factorycrew
description: Kira, a Factorio companion: ask about your live run from an in-game window; she reads the save, answers in the tab and marks places on the map.
author: umaxfun
configuration: Start Factorio with the launch option --enable-lua-udp 34200 (Steam: Factorio > Properties > Launch Options).
Turn on agent.session_control in Kiro Crew settings: the dispatcher opens one chat per in-game tab.
The app installs the kc-companion mod into your Factorio mods folder when it starts; enable it in the game's Mods menu if it is off. Any mod turns Steam achievements off for that save.
